<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>harbor.implicit</key><string>North %n %@</string>
  <key>harbor.middle</key><string>%@ dock %n %@</string>
  <key>harbor.repeated</key><string>%n%n %@ port</string>
  <key>harbor.explicit</key><string>%2$n %1$@ dock</string>
  <key>harbor.mixed</key><string>%2$n %@ dock</string>
  <key>harbor.overlap</key><string>%n %1$@ lane</string>
  <key>harbor.integer</key><string>%n %d markers</string>
  <key>harbor.escaped</key><string>%%n %@ tide</string>
  <key>harbor.unicode.🧭</key><string>🧭%n %@ reef</string>
</dict>
</plist>
